          ^
          This offer only applies to new applications for an RBC Avion Visa Infinite Business credit card received between August 25th, 2026 and November 30th, 2026 (“Offer Period”) and approved by Royal Bank of Canada (“Royal Bank”), subject to the conditions below. Only the primary business owner on the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Business credit card account (“Credit Card Account”) is eligible for the offer; any additional business owner(s) and cardholder(s), existing RBC Avion Visa Infinite Business cardholders as of the offer eligibility period, as well as existing cardholders of any RBC Business credit cards transferring to the RBC Avion Visa Infinite Business credit card as of the Offer Period, are not eligible for this offer.

          You will receive 45,000 welcome Avion points (“Welcome Points”) distributed as follows:
          • 25,000 Avion points will appear on your monthly credit card statement within sixty (60) days after your application has been approved.
          • 20,000 Avion points will appear on your monthly credit card statement within 60 days after your first purchase transaction posting date, provided your first purchase is posted to your Credit Card Account within the first three (3) months from your Credit Card Account opening date.
          You will be eligible to receive up to 55,000 bonus Avion points if you meet the conditions below:

          You will receive 20,000 Avion Points (“Bonus Points”) if (i) a total of $5,000 or more in qualifying net purchases and/or pre-authorized bill payment transactions (“Qualifying Transactions”) is posted to your Credit Card Account within the first 3 months from your Credit Card Account opening date (“3-month Period”). The Bonus Points will appear on your monthly credit card statement approximately 60 days after the 3-month Period.

          You will receive an additional 35,000 Avion points (“Additional Bonus Points”) if a total of $15,000 or more in Qualifying Transactions is posted to your Credit Card Account within the first 6 months from your Credit Card Account opening date (“6-month Period”). The Additional Bonus Points will appear on your monthly credit card statement approximately 60 days after the 6-month Period.

          Qualifying Transactions exclude cash advances (including balance transfers, cash-like transactions and bill payments that are not pre-authorized charges that you set up with a merchant), interest charges and fees, and credits for returns and adjustments will reduce the amount of your Qualifying Transactions. The amounts of $5,000 and $15,000 are calculated based on the transaction posting date of each Qualifying Transaction, not the transaction date. For example, this means that transactions that take place prior to the last day of the 3-month Period will not count toward the $5,000 if they have not yet been posted or processed by the merchant, the payment network (Visa) or Royal Bank by the last day of the 3-month Period. However, these Qualifying Transactions may count toward the $15,000 for the 6-month Period if they are posted to your Credit Card Account right after the 3-month Period.

          For more clarity, the amount of $5,000 in Qualifying Transactions and the amount of $15,000 in Qualifying Transactions are not cumulative, meaning that if a total of $15,000 in Qualifying Transactions is posted to your Credit Card Account within the first 6 months from your Credit Card Account opening date, including $5,000 within the first 3 months, you’ll be eligible for the Bonus Points and the Additional Bonus Points, provided you meet all other conditions. However, if you do not spend $5,000 in Qualifying Purchases within the first 3 months of your Credit Card Account opening date, but spend a total of $15,000 in Qualifying Purchases in the first 6 months from your Credit Card Account opening date, you will not be eligible for the Bonus Points but you will be eligible to receive the Additional Bonus Points, provided you meet all other conditions. Only Qualifying Transactions made by the primary owner on the Credit Card Account count toward the amount of $5,000 and $15,000 in Qualifying Transactions.

          The Welcome Points, Bonus Points and the Additional Bonus Points will be awarded to your Credit Card Account, provided your Credit Card Account is open and in good standing at the time they are awarded to your account, “good standing” meaning that your Credit Card Account must not be past due for more than two (2) consecutive Credit Card Account statement periods, closed, charged off or in credit revoked status at that time.

          Annual Fee waiver:

          The primary business owner will be exempt from the annual fee for the first year. For clarity, any additional business owner(s) and cardholder(s) on the Credit Card Account are not eligible for the annual fee waiver.

          If you close your Credit Card Account or change it for another type of RBC Royal Bank credit card before the Welcome Points, the Bonus Points and/or the Additional Bonus Points have been awarded to your account, you may lose the benefit of the offer. This offer may not be combined or used in conjunction with any other offer. Royal Bank reserves the right to modify, cancel or withdraw this offer at any time without notice, even after your application has been approved, including if we suspect that you may be manipulating or abusing it, or engaging in any suspicious or fraudulent activity, as determined by us in our sole discretion.
